quandoUsar: Event or meeting cards that show a title and time and reveal agenda and attendees on request.
Dense summaries in a dashboard that can also grow sideways when opened, with `width` and `expandedWidth`.
Cards whose supporting line changes over time: only the new words of `description` animate.
quandoEvitar: Use `collapsible` when the open state needs to be controlled from outside; this card only accepts `defaultExpanded`.
Use `center-morph-modal` when the details are long and deserve a focused window.
Use `accordion` for a list of sections where only one is open at a time.

teclado.acao: On the header, opens or closes the card.
With the card open and focus inside it, closes it and returns focus to the header.

acessibilidade: The header is a `<button>` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`; when closed, the panel is `inert`, out of focus and out of the screen reader.
The animated `description` has a hidden copy for the screen reader, which reads the whole sentence instead of loose words.
movimento: Width and height grow on the same no-overshoot spring, with real size instead of scale, so text, border, and corners do not stretch.
On close, the details fade first and the box shrinks 60 ms later; on open, they appear once the box has made room, and the arrow rotates 180°.
With “reduce motion” on, the card opens and closes instantly.
responsivo: An observer measures the available width: the card stays centered, never exceeds the container, and `width` and `expandedWidth` work only as limits.
notasIA: There is no `expanded` or `onExpandedChange`: the state is internal and starts from `defaultExpanded`.
Without `width`, the card fills the container; for it to grow sideways on open, pass both limits, such as `width={360}` and `expandedWidth={460}`.
`title` and `description` are text; the details go in `children`. Import from `@/components/ryan-ui/expandable-card/expandable-card`.
